title: Foundations of GenIR
extended_summary:
This chapter/paper discusses the foundational role of generative AI models in information access (IA) systems. It argues that modern generative models, especially large language models (LLMs), create new opportunities for IA through two broad paradigms: information generation and information synthesis. Information generation refers to directly producing tailored outputs from user instructions, while information synthesis refers to integrating external sources to produce grounded responses and reduce hallucinations.

The paper is a conceptual survey and framework paper rather than an empirical study. It reviews model architectures such as Transformers, scaling laws, training stages including pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and RLHF, prompt optimization, and multimodal applications. It also surveys retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), modular RAG, and related approaches for using LLMs to combine retrieval with generation.

The paper further discusses generative retrieval and domain-specific modeling as ways of using generative AI to model corpora and answer information needs directly. Its main conclusion is that generative AI can substantially enhance information access, but important challenges remain, including hallucination, efficiency, controllability, and the difficulty of effectively integrating external knowledge with large models.
quality_tier_rationale: This is a conceptual/chapter-style review of generative AI foundations and information access, not an empirical study with a measured educational intervention. It provides no study design, sample, or outcome evaluation relevant to K-12 evidence criteria.
impact_tier_rationale: The paper does not report any educational outcomes, effect sizes, or student-level impacts. Its relevance to middle school mathematics or subgroup effects is only indirect through broad discussion of LLMs like ChatGPT.

interventions.use_case: Uses ChatGPT and related large language models as examples of generative AI systems that can directly answer user questions and support information access, including chatbot-style query answering and retrieval-augmented generation.
